title: Cassia auriculata essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Cassia auriculata essential oil is a concentrated aromatic extract derived from the flowers of the Cassia auriculata plant, commonly known as the golden shower tree. This oil is valued in herbalism for its potential anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. It is often used in aromatherapy to support respiratory health and to help alleviate symptoms of colds and coughs. Additionally, it may be applied topically to soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. In traditional medicine, it is also used to aid digestion and reduce stress.
